1. Audit cohort
42 admissions: 7 chief complaints × 6
loop outcome: V2 31 accepted / 11 rejected,
V4 22 / 20
selection script not recovered

3. Two rationales per admission and stage
V2 diagnosis stage · V4 ICD coding stage
loop: generator–verifier loop (Qwen3-32B)
zero-shot: no verifier loop
→ 84 pairs, 168 rationales
